Alger, 11 novembre 2026 (Algeria Tech) —: Algiers, November 11, 2026 (Algeria Tech) — Bomare Company announced that 85% of its annual production of three million televisions will be exported under international brands, marking a transition toward a 45% physical integration rate and significant foreign currency gains.
Production et Exportation : Une Stratégi: Production and Export: A Global Strategy
Bomare Company a initié un projet de pro: Bomare Company has initiated a project to produce three million televisions annually, marking a significant evolution for the company. This new phase sees the company transition from a reliance on imported components to a 45% physical integration rate. Out of the total volume of three million units produced, 85% are destined for export, marketed under renowned global brands.
L'entreprise anticipe un gain d'environ: The company anticipates a gain of approximately 45% in foreign currency on the 2.5 million televisions to be commercialized. This strategy aims to significantly boost the foreign exchange reserves of the Algerian Treasury. Bomare Company aims to reach a stage within three years, and by 2030, where the export of these 2.5 million televisions will be entirely financed by its own foreign currency resources.
L'Export comme Levier de Performance Ind: Export as a Lever for Industrial Performance
Lors de son deuxième Afterwork, consacré: During its second Afterwork event, dedicated to export, Bomare Company advocated the idea of making export ambition an economic driver. The company views export as a global value chain, integrating industry, compliance, innovation, and customer experience. This meeting broadened the reflection on the capacity of local actors to conquer international markets, emphasizing that a sustainable industry requires skills, logistics, and after-sales service.
La nouvelle usine de Bomare Company, cap: Bomare Company's new factory, capable of producing up to three million televisions per year, supports the development of its own brand, STREAM. It also paves the way for OEM and ODM subcontracting partnerships, enabling manufacturing tailored to customer specifications.
L'accès aux marchés d'exportation impose: Access to export markets imposes specific requirements, particularly regarding regulatory compliance and traceability. For the European market, mastering the CE marking is essential, attesting to compliance with legal requirements. The RoHS directive restricts the use of hazardous substances and requires rigorous control of component origins. Bomare Company integrates these standards right from the product design stage, as evidenced by its durability and reparability index of 6.8/10.
